REVISED ROLLING 12-MONTH MAINTENANCE PLAN

OUTAGE
IMPACT REPORT UPDATE

 

Natural
has posted an updated Outage Impact Report on its website.

 

The
report outlines scheduled projects that may affect customers and includes:

 

·
        

Impacted
pipeline segments

·
        

Estimated
start and finish dates

·
        

Brief
project descriptions

·
        

Anticipated
shipper impacts

 

Changes
to existing projects and newly added projects are highlighted in yellow for
easy reference.  In addition, Natural will continue to post detailed updates on
specific maintenance projects with direct shipper impacts on its interactive
website as needed.  The full maintenance plan is accessible via Natural's
portal page or by clicking the link below:

 

Outage
Impact Report - 3-12-26

 

If
you have any questions, please contact your Account Director or Scheduling
Representative.

 

 

.
